verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents first-party Jira Cloud and Linear integrations: it creates tasks from tickets, and for Linear it also syncs issue status and links artifacts back to the source issue. GitHub issues are supported too. However, the evidence frames the flow as tickets driving HumanLayer tasks, not agents directly creating, editing, or closing tickets. ClickUp and Monday.com are never mentioned. Missing for 10: ClickUp and Monday.com integrations, evidence that agents can directly create, update, or close tickets (beyond Linear status sync), Jira status sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
